answer: Vesting rewards behind a retroactive fraud window makes each fake identity expensive. Every payout vests over 30 epochs, and during that time any peer can post a 50 POA challenge showing two seats share a funding source or reuse one hollow, copied answer. A proven link slashes all unvested rewards of both seats and pays the challenger. A farm of 100 fakes ties up 100 vesting balances and 30 epochs of capital, so one detected oasis of linked seats forfeits the whole farm; a fable of honest history cannot be bought quickly.
